property_summary: For every call to play() that sends exactly 11 wei the reference contract always reverts (rejects non-10 ticket), while the mutant accepts 11 and thus increases pot; equivalently: for all callers and balances, calling play() with msg.value == 11 either (in the reference) leaves pot unchanged and/or reverts, but in the mutant there exist inputs where the call succeeds and pot increases — the test checks that calling play() with msg.value == 11 always fails on the reference.
change_summary: Change the required ticket payment from TICKET_AMOUNT to TICKET_AMOUNT + 1 so play will revert unless different value is sent, altering pot updates when calls succeed.
